highlights.title: Flash flood sweeps away buildings in Nepal
highlights.summary: Flash flooding in Nepal has swept away buildings along the Budhi Gandaki river on Sunday.

highlights.title: Riyadh airport strike kills 12, Saudi Arabia threatens 'decisive' response
highlights.summary: Saudi Arabia vowed to retaliate against Yemen’s Houthi rebels on Sunday after a strike on Riyadh’s international airport killed a dozen people and wounded more than 300, marking the kingdom's deadliest strike in a decade.

highlights.title: Delhi braces for more protests as 'cockroach' group's leaders released
highlights.summary: The leaders, including CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke, had been detained when they arrived in Delhi on Saturday.

highlights.title: What to Know About the Protests in India
highlights.summary: More demonstrations against sweeping revisions to India’s voter rolls are expected on Sunday in New Delhi. The police met earlier protests with an extraordinary show of force.

highlights.title: Pfeifer: América do Sul precisa de agenda coesa para ganhar lugar no mundo
highlights.summary: Coordenador-geral do grupo de Defesa, Segurança e Inteligência da USP afirma que países do continente tentaram buscar maior integração regional, mas ações tiveram pouco efeito nos últimos anos

highlights.title: Vinicius apologises for hair-pull red card but could miss El Clasico
highlights.summary: Real Madrid forward has a goal disallowed, is sent off for the hair-pull offence and could miss the next three games.
